en: The image is a black-and-white multi-view postcard featuring four distinct scenes from a rural and hilly town. There are panoramic vistas of a valley, a church with twin towers, scattered houses, farmlands, forests, and people standing at an overlook. The text in the center reads 'Schirgiswalde O.-L.'. The overall aesthetic suggests an older, possibly mid-20th-century period.
